clue.text: Union organiser?

parts.note: the union is a wedding, not a trade union, and the organiser is an agency that introduces couples

explanation.definitionFit: An agency that matches people seeking spouses organises unions in the matrimonial sense.

clue.text: Crazily, heartlessly sneaky

indicators.note: heartlessly tells us to remove the central letters of the word for crazily

parts.note: crazily means wildly

explanation.surface: Someone acting madly and without compassion is also being cunning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartlessly' strips LD, the middle pair, from WILDLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe someone cunning and underhand.

clue.text: Involve soldiers getting into rank, going backwards

indicators.note: getting into says the soldiers are placed inside the other word
going backwards says the word for rank is turned round

parts.note: a rank is a line, as of soldiers
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Joining up means soldiers falling into a rank that then retreats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going backwards' turns LINE into ENIL; 'getting into' puts TA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To entail something is to necessarily involve or require it.

clue.text: Fast flow of water beginning to challenge a sailor's feat

indicators.note: beginning to says only the opening letter of challenge is used

parts.note: a tar is an old word for a sailor
a feat is a deed or act

explanation.surface: A rapid torrent poses the first test of a seaman's daring exploit.
explanation.definitionFit: A cataract is a large waterfall or rush of water.

clue.text: Notary ties various papers etc.

indicators.note: various signals that the letters of the two words are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A notary bundles assorted documents with string.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing materials: paper, envelopes, pens and the like.

clue.text: A further advance on one's living quarters

definitions.text: A further advance on one's living quarters

parts.words: A further advance on one's living quarters
parts.note: an advance here is a loan, and a further one secured on one's home is an additional property loan

explanation.definitionFit: An additional loan secured against a house already carrying one.

clue.text: Lay in state?

parts.note: a lay is a song, and a state, meaning a country, has one official song

explanation.definitionFit: A country's official patriotic song is its lay in the sense of a ballad.

clue.text: Allowed 50% cut? That's fatal

parts.note: allowed means let

indicators.note: cut says the word is docked of its final letter

parts.note: 50 per cent is a half

explanation.surface: A permitted halving of something proves deadly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' takes F off HALF, leaving HAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean causing death.

clue.text: See 7
Be inquisitive about source of energy in quarry

indicators.note: about says the nosy word goes round the other letter

parts.note: to pry is to be nosy

indicators.note: source of takes just the initial letter of energy

explanation.surface: Someone nosy investigates where a quarry gets its power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'source of' gives E; 'about' puts PRY round it.
explanation.definitionFit: A hunted animal is the hunter's quarry or victim.

clue.text: Draw right soldiers back ahead of military engagement

indicators.note: ahead of puts the first part in front of the second
back says the two abbreviations are read in reverse order and direction

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
action is fighting or a battle

explanation.surface: A recruiting pull: correct troops retreat before a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A draw is something that pulls in crowds, an appeal.

clue.text: Group of businesses allowed group of motorists to return

indicators.note: to return says the two words together are read backwards

parts.note: allowed means let
the RAC is the Royal Automobile Club, a British motoring organisation

explanation.surface: A trade body permits a motoring club to come back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to return' turns LETRAC into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartel is a combine of firms fixing prices or output.

clue.text: Radio bringing varied strains to ear, ultimately

indicators.note: varied says the letters of strains are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: ultimately takes only the final letter of ear

explanation.surface: A wireless set brings assorted melodies to the listener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'varied' turns STRAINS into TRANSIS; 'ultimately' gives R from ear.
explanation.definitionFit: An old portable radio set was commonly called by the name of its component.

clue.text: An account about US lawyer represented as a snake

parts.note: on means about, concerning
a DA is a district attorney in the US

explanation.surface: An American attorney's report describes something as a serpent.
explanation.definitionFit: A large South American constrictor.

clue.text: Praises former sailor (leader taking rearguard role)

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: says the front letter of the sailor word goes to the back

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor

explanation.surface: An ex-navy man is commended for leading from the rear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader taking rearguard role' moves S from the start of SALT to its end, giving ALTS.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol or glorify someone is to praise them highly.

clue.text: Worked endlessly to test cosmetic?

indicators.note: endlessly drops the final letter of the word

parts.note: toiled means worked hard
to try is to test

explanation.surface: Laboured without end trying out a beauty product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' takes D off TOILED; the question mark admits a cosmetic is only one example of a toiletry.
explanation.definitionFit: A toiletry is an item for personal grooming, such as a cosmetic.

clue.text: Form of water found around river or other waterway

indicators.note: around says the vapour word encloses the letter

parts.note: steam is water as vapour

explanation.surface: A kind of water flows round a river or another channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A brook or small river is a watercourse.

clue.text: See 6
Light sent skyward in some fleeting instant

indicators.note: sent skyward says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A flash shooting up for a brief moment.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'sent skyward' reads upwards: ETINGI from 'fleeting instant' turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: To light something is to set it on fire.

clue.text: Causing shame in a severe critique

parts.note: a bashing is a fierce attack in words

explanation.surface: A harsh review makes its subject embarrassed.
explanation.definitionFit: To abash is to embarrass or humiliate.

clue.text: See 1
They lay out requests? Not right

indicators.note: not says the following letter is to be left out

parts.note: prayers are requests or entreaties

explanation.surface: Those spreading their pleas are wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not right' removes an R from PRAYERS; to lay out money is to pay it.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who spend or hand over money settle bills.

clue.text: Rough stone water supplier all but frozen, but not quite

indicators.note: all but means everything except the last letter

parts.note: a pump supplies water

indicators.note: not quite drops the final letter of the frozen word

parts.note: iced means frozen

explanation.surface: A rough rock delivers water that is nearly frozen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all but' gives PUM; 'not quite' gives ICE.
explanation.definitionFit: A light porous volcanic rock used for scrubbing skin.

clue.text: Music prone to be broadcast in part of theatre

indicators.note: broadcast scatters the letters, so the words are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Songs likely to be aired in the stage area.
explanation.definitionFit: The arch framing the front of a stage.

clue.text: 100 years, say, in prison

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
an age is a long span of years

explanation.surface: A century behind bars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks AGE as a loose way of putting 'years'.
explanation.definitionFit: A barred enclosure confines like a jail.

clue.text: One moving sideways runs into taxi

indicators.note: into puts the letter inside the vehicle word

parts.note: a cab is a taxi
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A sidestepper sprints straight into a cab.
explanation.definitionFit: A crustacean famous for scuttling crosswise.

clue.text: Post office?

parts.note: a post here is a job, so the office finds work, not letters

explanation.definitionFit: A government job centre placing workers in posts was once so named in Britain.

clue.text: See 25
